name: Relay
line: WhatsApp campaigns from one Excel sheet.
desc: Upload a consented contact list, send approved WhatsApp templates in controlled batches, and track delivery, reads and replies. Optional Instagram and Facebook comment-to-message is included.
features: WhatsApp promotional campaigns from an Excel sheet
steps: Connect your WhatsApp Business number securely.
Upload an Excel sheet with opt-in recorded and an explicit country for local numbers.
Pick an APPROVED template and personalise with columns from your sheet.
Delivered in controlled batches that protect your number.
Simple rules handle STOP and keywords. Unmatched replies stay in your inbox.
A comment on Instagram or Facebook can get a private message back.
ba: Messages sent one at a time
One campaign reaches the whole list
Each comment can get a private reply

pricing.note: Customer-facing USD list from the product guide. Annual billing charges 10 months (two months saved). INR prices stay configurable until approved.

note: Mira handoff and the shared multi-agent TWWIOS shell are not shipped in this Relay package. Do not advertise them as available.
